description:
GS1 EPCIS 2.0 supply-chain events. `export`, `capture`, `capture_job` and `query` are on every plan, Free included. Captured events count against the plan's event allowance (10 a month on Free); over it `capture` returns an overage or hard-block message.

Actions (pass via `action`; `{…}` is the `args` object):
- export, export_by_serial — { id } or { serial, gtin? } (on 409 ambiguous_serial pass `gtin`). A passport's events as an EPCIS 2.0 JSON-LD document. Read-only.
- capture — { events }. An EPCISDocument, a single event, or an array of events (JSON-LD). Returns 202 with a captureJobId.
- capture_job — { jobId }. Poll a capture job. Read-only.
- query — { params? }. Standard EPCIS query parameters as key/value (EQ_bizStep, GE_eventTime, MATCH_epc, …). Read-only.
name: tracepass_epcis
title: TracePass EPCIS 2.0
